blocks.text: In A2 you have learned the weak verbs of form I ( ⁧قَالَ⁩ , ⁧مَشَى⁩ , ⁧وَصَلَ⁩ , ⁧ظَنَّ⁩ ). In derived forms the same roots produce some of the most frequent verbs of the written language: ⁧أَقَامَ⁩ , ⁧اِخْتَارَ⁩ , ⁧اِسْتَفَادَ⁩ , ⁧اِنْتَهَى⁩ , ⁧أَلْغَى⁩ , ⁧أَدَّى⁩ , ⁧اِتَّصَلَ⁩ , ⁧اِسْتَمَرَّ⁩ . Their forms are missing from a letter, and those who do not know how to reconstruct it do not find the root in the dictionary and do not recognize the verb in the sentence. In this unit you tidy up the system: for each type of weak root see what happens in every form, with conjugation, the maṣdar And the participants. Three weeks.
